name: Muslim American Youth Foundation
mission: Our mission is to educate, enrich, and enlighten young Muslim-Americans with the tools they need to thrive—in their communities and within the broader American society.
theoryOfChange: The Muslim American Youth Foundation (MAYF) outlines its strategic approach on its 'About Us' page, under a section titled 'Our Strategy'. This section details how their programs are 'rooted in helping youth develop a strong sense of personal, academic, and spiritual identity' and how they 'equip young people with the discipline, skills, and knowledge they need to overcome challenges and navigate life with confidence, purpose and a commitment to community service'. Their core mission is to 'educate and empower Muslim-American youth through programs that are both culturally relevant and spiritually grounded', with an approach that 'centers on strengthening identity, values, and purpose'. Every MAYF program, including tutoring, mentoring, athletics, and spiritual guidance, is designed to 'strengthen this foundation and support the holistic development of the next generation'. Furthermore, their approach addresses challenges faced by Muslim-American youth through 'mentorship, education, and counseling' to 'strengthen identity, build resilience, and provide youth with the tools and support they need to resist harmful influences and thrive'. This collectively serves as a program strategy document, explaining how their activities lead to impact.
